title: Three Winters and One Short Brim
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：hat　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hat 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the hatter ① blocked the hat that no apprentice in the workshop would have described, and he said the blocking was the whole of the winter. The ② hat, meaning the crown itself and not the brim, ran three winters and stayed undescribed in the book; a hat, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ hat in that workshop had the same short brim beside it, and the ④ hat at the far shelf, meaning the felt they kept for the children to try on and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A hat, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the hatter said the describing is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the hat was the whole of the matter, meaning the trade and not the crown. The ⑥ hat, meaning the trade and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; hat, he said, is either something you block or the only word that means both a crown and a trade. He said the trade is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ hat had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short brim. The ⑧ hat of the whole thing, the hatter wrote in November, was one workshop and three winters of describing; hat, he said, is either the felt at the far shelf or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ hat I remember is the crown described in the ledger, which closed in 1975 and is still described as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ hat, my mother said in 1977, is the only crown that improves by being described; every hat, she said, is a trade that has agreed to look like a crown. She said the trade was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 帽子（指作坊里每一顶旁边的那一顶）
B. n. 帽子（指那顶帽冠本身，与帽檐相对）
C. 固定搭配：block the hat 给帽子定型
D. n. 帽子（指留给孩子们学着戴的那一顶）
E. n. 帽事（抽象总称，指一处作坊的帽子之事）
F. n. 帽子（指账簿里写到、被记下的的那一顶）
G. n. 手艺、行当（指一件事里人人都戴却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 行当（抽象总称，指人人都戴却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: blocked the hat that no apprentice in the workshop would have described
The hat, meaning the crown itself and not the brim
the hat at the far shelf
the hat was the whole of the matter
the hat had become a line in a ledger
The hat of the whole thing
A hat, my mother said in 1977

answers.why: block the hat 意为“给帽子定型”，1968 年那位帽匠把作坊里没有一位学徒肯描述的一顶帽子做了一遍。
hat 意为“帽子”，指那顶帽冠本身而不是帽檐，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被描述。
hat 意为“帽子”，指作坊里每一顶旁边的那一顶，每一顶旁边都有同一道窄窄的帽檐。
hat 意为“帽子”，指最远那层架子留给孩子们学着戴的那一顶，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
hat 意为“手艺、行当”，指一件事里人人都戴却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这门手艺就是那件事的全部。
hat 意为“行当”，指人人都戴却无人提起的那样东西而不是那顶帽冠，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
hat 意为“帽子”，指账簿里写到、被记下的的那一顶，到 1973 年这一顶成了账簿里的一行。
hat 意为“帽事”，帽匠十一月写道，整件事的帽子之事是一处作坊和三个冬天的描述。
hat 意为“帽子”，我记得的是账簿里描述过的那一顶，1975 年关停了，至今仍被说成作坊里最安静的一顶。
hat 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，帽子是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的帽冠。
